Music Tuition
Music tuition, taught by specialist peripatetic Hampshire Music Service teachers, can be organised for KS2 children at Western. Children can learn cello, violin, brass, woodwind or guitar in small groups during 20 minute, small group lessons which take place during the school day.
Tuition fees at highly competitive rates are charged termly and instruments can be hired from Hampshire Music Service. Please speak to a member of the office staff for more information or to register interest.
